columns.title: Plan Begin Date
columns.description: yyyy-mm-dd plan begin date (set by the Command Center app from Stedi Plan Begin Date; copied date→date down the pipeline so the format never changes)

columns.title: SNF/Hospice/Hospital
columns.description: Stedi eligibility: active Hospice election / Hospital-SNF stay (mirror of the Subscription Board column). Written on every Medicare check; cleared when no longer active.

columns.title: Reason for Inquiry
columns.description: Step 1 of the DTC intake form — why the patient came to us.

labels.label: I want off the finger prick / try a pump

columns.title: State
columns.description: Patient home state from the intake form. Drives primaryInsurance.ts home-state routing.

columns.title: Pump Need
columns.description: From the form. Input to the derived Request Type and Insulin Pump Coverage Path.

columns.title: Provided CGM Preference
columns.description: Patient's verbatim CGM answer from the form. Distinct from the verified CGM Type.

columns.title: Provided Pump Preference
columns.description: Patient's verbatim pump answer from the form. Distinct from the verified Pump Type.

columns.title: Provided Doctor Name
columns.description: Form: 'Provider name (or clinic name)'. Write-once, never overwritten by Select Correct Provider. Distinct from the verified Doctor Name (text_mm1x46et).

columns.title: Provided Clinic Phone
columns.description: Form: 'Clinic phone or location'. Free text — may hold either a phone or an address, so it is deliberately not a phone column.

columns.title: Insurance Provided Via
columns.description: How the patient supplied their insurance on the form.

columns.title: Insurance (Other) - as typed
columns.description: Free text the patient typed when they picked 'Other' for their insurance carrier.

columns.title: Secondary Insurance (as provided)
columns.description: The form's raw payer answer. Distinct from the condensed board label set in Secondary Insurance (color_mm1zbrx0).

labels.label: Anthem or Blue Cross Blue Shield

columns.title: Secondary Member ID (as provided)
columns.description: Optional secondary member ID as the patient entered it on the form.

columns.title: Insurance Card Photo
columns.description: Card photos captured on the intake form. No OCR — a rep reads these to fill the verified insurance fields.

columns.title: Proceed Preference
columns.description: Last question on the form. 'Send request now' satisfies condition 1 of the advance-unlock rule; 'Wants a call first' requires Intake Call Complete instead.

columns.title: Call Slot - Selected on Form
columns.description: The callback slot the patient picked on the form. Rep can override; the override lives in its own column.

columns.title: Booking Status
columns.description: Whether a callback slot has been picked.

columns.title: Drop-off Step
columns.description: Furthest step a partial lead reached before abandoning. Set on every forward step; 'Completed' once the form is submitted.

columns.title: Form Session ID
columns.description: Client-generated session ID. Used to match a partial lead to its completed submission and to dedupe beacons.

columns.title: Self Advocacy
columns.description: Care Assessment. Rep-entered on the call. Optional — must tolerate blank.

columns.title: Current Out-of-Pocket Cost
columns.description: Cost & Coverage. Rep-entered on the call. Text, not numeric — reps capture things like '$75/month' or '$400 per 90 days'. Optional.

columns.title: CGM Data & Doctor Awareness
columns.description: Rep-entered on the call. Deliberately not on the patient form — phone-call only.

columns.title: CGM Data File
columns.description: Written by the tokenized patient upload link, or dropped in by the rep. Accepts jpg/png/heic/pdf/csv.

columns.title: Attempt Counter
columns.description: Unified contact attempts — automated email/text, autodialer and manual rep calls all roll into this one number.

columns.title: Intake Call Complete
columns.description: Rep-side equivalent of the patient choosing 'Send request now'. Satisfies condition 1 of the advance-unlock rule for a patient who asked for a call first.

columns.title: Intake Escalation
columns.description: Mirrors the Medical Evaluation escalation model. Index 0 = escalated to Manager Intervention; index 2 = Proposed Stuck, which promotes to Final Decisions; index 1 = resolved. An escalated patient is excluded from the rep queue and burndown.

columns.title: Intake Escalation Notes
columns.description: Append-style log of escalation reasons and manager decisions for the intake stage.

columns.title: Rx Docs to Patient
columns.description: Did the prescription template reach the patient by email and text after they chose "send my request now"? Written automatically by the intake backend.

columns.title: Rx Docs Detail
columns.description: Why the prescription documents did not fully send — which channel failed and the error. Empty when everything went out.

columns.title: Scheduled Call Time
columns.description: The booked intake call, mirrored from Calendly (date + time, Eastern). Written by the dtc-mm-form backend on booking and corrected by the Calendly webhook on reschedule/cancel. Calendly is the system of record; this is a read model so the Command Center can query bookings like any other stage.

columns.title: Calendly Event URI
columns.description: The Calendly scheduled_event URI for this patient's booked intake call. Used to cancel a booking and to tell a live cancellation from a stale one during a reschedule (which arrives as cancel + create with a new URI). Written by the dtc-mm-form backend; not rep-editable.

columns.title: Last Form Activity
columns.description: When the patient last touched the DTC intake form. Written by the form backend on every /track beacon. This is the clock the drop-off nudge keys on — deliberately NOT monday's updated_at, which moves when anyone edits the row and would silently reset the timer.

columns.title: Drop-off Text Sent
columns.description: When the one-time drop-off nudge text was sent. Claimed BEFORE the send, so a slow or retried send cannot become two texts. A patient is nudged once, ever — a non-empty value here permanently excludes them.

columns.title: Dup Check Analysis
columns.description: Claude's written analysis of a confirmed Already-In-System match: which identifiers linked the records, where the existing patient is in the pipeline, and what the new referral changes. Written by josh-monday-automations (duplicate-analysis). Currently in shadow mode - analysis goes to ntfy only.

columns.title: Matched Patient UID
columns.description: Patient UID of the existing record this referral matched, so a rep can jump straight to it. The UID is a shared cross-board identity (Medical Evaluation / Insurance / Welcome Call / Subscription). Written by josh-monday-automations (duplicate-analysis).

columns.title: Dup Check Result
columns.description: Outcome of the duplicate check. Distinguishes a real "no match" from a check that could not run - Already In System alone cannot express that. Written by josh-monday-automations (duplicate-analysis).

columns.title: Drop-off Attempt
columns.description: How many drop-off outreach attempts have been sent to this patient (1 = the 24h email+text, 2 = the 48h reminder). Written by dtc-mm-form-api's sweep. Capped at 2.

columns.title: Intake Sub-Stage
columns.description: Stage advancer for the Patient Intake split. Info Collection (the DTC form groups) -> Profile Clean-Up (its own group). Written by the Command Center only, LAST in a verified write.

columns.title: Resume Link Sent
columns.description: When the patient was first texted their "Save & finish later" link. Set once, by the form backend, and never overwritten — it is what stops a second tap texting a second link.

columns.title: Insurance Link Sent
columns.description: When the patient was first texted the "upload your insurance card whenever you have it" link, after answering "I don't have it on me". Set once by the form backend; the rep's Start Insurance Follow-Up can still send the link again.

columns.title: Intake Warnings
columns.description: Written by the backend after each benefits check. One warning per line: KEY|TYPE|message (TYPE = BLOCK or CONFIRM:<label>).

columns.title: Intake Warning Acks
columns.description: Written by Command Center. Comma-separated warning KEYs the rep confirmed (e.g. MEDICARE_PUMP_MEDICAID_ID).
